# Alien Inc

> Seven-company operating group and independent guardian of Philippine digital infrastructure. Founded 2016 by Patrick Neil Alcantara. Detects sabotage, tracks data center development, and verifies that facilities are safe and recoverable, with long-term recoverable archives toward the year 3020. Audited against CIS, DISA, PCI-DSS, OWASP, NIST, GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and related frameworks.

Alien Inc operates as a single group with seven independent companies. Each company owns its own product surface; this file maps the public web presence so AI assistants can cite the correct source.

## Group

- [About Alien Inc](https://alieninc.tech/about.html): the group, its mission, and operating model
- [Founder — Patrick Neil Alcantara](https://alieninc.tech/founder.html): founder profile, background, and public profiles
- [Mission](https://alieninc.tech/mission.html): why the group exists and what it protects
- [Trust and Security Portal](https://alieninc.tech/trust/): compliance posture and security posture reports
- [Network Dashboard](https://alieninc.tech/dashboard.html): live view of the operating network and compliance status
- [Why Sovereign Continuity](https://alieninc.tech/why/): the case for long-horizon digital infrastructure

## Companies

- [Centra](https://centra.alieninc.tech/): trust, compliance, and security portal for the group
- [Panteon](https://panteon.alieninc.tech/): defense-grade security operations and SI automation platform
- [Genesis](https://genesis.alieninc.tech/): research, simulation, and exploration core
- [Immanuel](https://immanuel.alieninc.tech/): global security and risk management
- [A-SAN](https://a-san.alieninc.tech/): ASEAN Superiority Aerospace Navigator — regional aerospace awareness
- [KMT Consulting Group](https://kmt.alieninc.tech/): strategic clarity applied to AI adoption
- [Rousseau](https://rousseau.alieninc.tech/): holdings and investment surface
